text: DSH Side Chat 为 DSH 网页端在主对话旁增加可调整宽度的侧聊抽屉。它从当前会话分出独立子会话，可把选中的原对话文本引用到草稿中，并通过 /sidechat 打开侧聊或预填草稿；侧聊记录以独立关系存储，界面展示对话时间线。适合想在不离开主会话的情况下并行追问或探索另一条思路的 DSH Web 用户。

DSH Side Chat adds a resizable drawer beside the main conversation in DSH Web. It forks the current session into a side chat, can quote selected text into a draft, and opens or pre-fills chats with /sidechat. Users can explore another question while keeping the main session in view.
想在 DSH 主对话旁边开个独立窗口继续追问，不切走当前会话。
能不能把对话里选中的一段引用到新的侧聊草稿里，让我围绕它另开一条思路？
I want to branch off a DSH conversation and keep the side discussion next to the original chat.
DSH Side Chat 的功能「从选中文本创建侧聊」：在主对话选中一段文字后点击浮动提问按钮，插件会分叉当前会话，并把选中文字作为引用放入侧聊草稿，供用户继续编辑。

@dsh-external/dsh-sidechat README · DSH Side Chat：[中文说明](README.zh.md)

A standalone [DeepSeek Harness Web](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds a Codex-style side chat beside the main conversation. It uses Harness public Session, Storage Domain, Workspace Registry, and Connection RPC surfaces without modifying the official Harness source.

@dsh-external/dsh-sidechat README · Highlights：- Split the main conversation and side chat into two resizable panes instead of covering the main chat.
- Create a side chat from the current conversation, including selected-text quoting without automatic sending.
- Keep the child Session out of the official left sidebar while preserving its original log after relationship removal.
- Show parent title, short Session ID, summary, and a live “follows main-chat permissions” indicator.
- Choose a model and reasoning effort independently for each side chat; a new side chat initially inherits the main chat model.
- Use `/sidechat` to open the current or most recently updated side chat, or `/sidechat content` to fill its draft.
- Render user messages, Markdown, reasoning, tool activity, approvals, questions, slash-command lifecycle, and unknown events through a generic timeline.
- Navigate both conversations with compact Codex-style Turn rails: quiet equal ticks when idle, fisheye expansion and a preview card on hover.
- Generate a title from the first side-chat question, with manual rename taking permanent precedence.

@dsh-external/dsh-sidechat README · Install into a Harness checkout：The plugin is currently distributed as a local `link:` package. Keep the plugin checkout next to the Harness checkout so its relative development links resolve:

```text
workspace/
├─ deepseek-harness-proxy/
└─ dsh-sidechat/
```

Build the plugin and install it into the Web profile:

```powershell
cd path\to\dsh-sidechat
$env:HTTP_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890'
$env:HTTPS_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890'
pnpm install

@dsh-external/dsh-sidechat README · Install into a Harness checkout：The package has no `prepare` script. After changing `src/`, run `pnpm run build` and restart the Web profile so it loads the new `lib/client.js`.

@dsh-external/dsh-sidechat README · Development：```powershell
cd path\to\dsh-sidechat
$env:HTTP_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890'
$env:HTTPS_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:7890'
pnpm install

The development dependencies use `link:` references to a sibling Harness checkout. Harness remains a peer/runtime dependency; this repository does not vendor or patch the official source.

@dsh-external/dsh-sidechat README · Architecture：The Host half owns the `dsh_sidechat` storage domain, parent/child lineage validation, title and summary persistence, archive retry, permission synchronization, model inheritance, and the private loopback `/dsh-sidechat` RPC channel.

@dsh-external/dsh-sidechat README · Architecture：The Client half registers the native header action, split-screen overlay, selection action, slash-command source, model selector, generic timeline, and main/side Turn history rails. Draft text and pane width stay local to the browser; relationship records and titles are the only side-chat metadata persisted by the plugin.

@dsh-external/dsh-sidechat README · Compatibility and privacy：- Designed for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile and its public plugin surfaces.
- Uses peer dependency ranges matching the current Harness checkout; test against the Harness revision you deploy.
- Side-chat RPC is restricted to the local Web connection boundary.
- Images and message drafts are sent through the child Session and are not written to the relationship table.
- Removing a side-chat relationship does not delete or unarchive the underlying Session log.
